engine.name: mlxcat-cache-held
engine.notes: Same binary and same ceiling as `mlxcat`; the only difference is the two env overrides. This arm is not a proposal — it is the control that makes the default's footprint claim a measurement. Note the peak column is per PROCESS and one process serves every tier of a model, so this arm's later cells inherit its 16k high-water mark; that inheritance IS the defect being priced.
